snippet.title: Look Outside: Final Vision | 2.0 Update | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Look Outside, the critically acclaimed survival horror RPG is taking on an even more terrifying new form in the Final Vision update: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373660/Look_Outside/

This free 2.0 update, available now for anyone who owns the base game, adds:

Multiple new endings
A surprise-filled Cursed challenge mode
New interactions
New areas
New quests
Dozens of new monsters
New boss battles
Horrible new secrets

Play it now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373660/Look_Outside/

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
